source.author: verg
source.text_english: At once Aeneas’s limbs are loosened by the cold:

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: iudex crudelis quasi superatus attollitur, illa dominum deprecatur; soluuntur membra compagibus, illa oculos ad caelum tendit; de communi scelere alius confitetur, illa pro confitente negat et periclitans ipsa alium uindicat periclitantem.
reuse.text_original: iudex crudelis quasi superatus attollitur, illa dominum deprecatur; soluuntur membra compagibus, illa oculos ad caelum tendit; de communi scelere alius confitetur, illa pro confitente negat et periclitans ipsa alium uindicat periclitantem.
reuse.text_english: The cruel judge, as though vanquished, is raised up; she pleads with the master; her limbs are loosened from their joints; she lifts her eyes to heaven; from their common crime one confesses, she denies on behalf of the confessor, and though herself in danger she defends another who is in danger.
